name: Dermatology
boundaries: Dermatology: fundamental discoveries and enabling technologies within this field. Include cross-field consequences where the central advance belongs to this field; exclude routine incremental optimization. Use the historical breakthroughs in the prompt to calibrate revolutionary impact.

original_dispositions.original_title: Scarless, full-thickness regeneration with appendages and nerves
One-time curative therapy for psoriasis and atopic dermatitis
original_dispositions.reason: Covered by DER-03. Barrier restoration, if still required after immune erasure, is stated there as an additional requirement. DER-07 is prevention, not this cure.

original_dispositions.original_title: Permanent reversal of photoaging and intrinsic skin aging
original_dispositions.reason: The wording bundles cosmetic matrix restoration with senescence reversal and a cancer benefit. Functional cancer prevention is DER-05 and DER-06; wound-repair decline in aged skin sits inside DER-01 and DER-09. A general reversal of human aging is geroscience. Elastic-fiber “rejuvenation” remains below the calibration bar used here.

original_dispositions.original_title: Universal prevention of all skin cancers by one vaccine or short course
original_dispositions.reason: Not added as its own ID. Ultraviolet-driven prevention is covered by DER-05 and DER-06. Melanoma and keratinocyte carcinoma do not share one preventive antigen, so “all skin cancers” is an unsupported bundle. Personalized neoantigen vaccines treat existing melanoma. They are not lifelong universal prevention.

original_dispositions.original_title: Bioengineered, patient-specific, vascularized, innervated, appendage-bearing skin
original_dispositions.reason: Covered by DER-01. The graft route was clarified in this revision so the overlap is explicit. It was not given a new ID.

original_dispositions.original_title: Real-time, single-cell, non-invasive margin detection aiming at 100 percent complete excision
original_dispositions.reason: Micrographic surgery already has low recurrence for basal and squamous carcinoma: a 2024 meta-analysis found 82 recurrences among 3,050 tumors treated by micrographic surgery, an overall rate of 3.1 percent. Better intraoperative imaging would save time and tissue. It would not create a new therapeutic principle at the scale of the calibration examples. The author list of that meta-analysis was not on the abstract page retrieved.

original_dispositions.original_title: Permanent cure for vitiligo with full, stable repigmentation
original_dispositions.reason: Immune memory and a destroyed melanocyte reservoir are different barriers. Combining them into one entry would hide that split.

original_dispositions.original_title: Safe systemic in vivo gene therapy for all severe genodermatoses
original_dispositions.reason: Covered by DER-02. Systemic delivery and off-target safety were written into that entry as routes and requirements. DER-04 is the intact-skin delivery barrier those routes still face.

original_dispositions.original_title: Rapid complete healing of all chronic wounds regardless of cause
original_dispositions.reason: Covered only in the narrower form of DER-09. The historical wording, “regardless of underlying cause or comorbidities,” was not adopted. Ischemia, neuropathy, venous hypertension, and unrelieved pressure are not solved by a skin-repair program.

original_dispositions.original_title: A master switch for permanent hair growth and permanent hair removal
original_dispositions.reason: Permanent reduction of unwanted hair is already pursued with lasers and electrolysis. Inducing new follicles where none remain is unsolved and is the appendage half of DER-01. Drugs that slow androgenetic alopecia already exist. A scalp-specific cure would affect many people and still would not reorganize skin repair, cancer, or genetic disease at the calibration magnitude.

reconciliation_change_log.reason: Three URLs are 404 or “page not found.” The two real journal issues do not contain the claimed special series. No historical source was used as evidence for a concept.
No concept was deleted, replaced, or merged away.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Amended DER-01 so autologous bioengineered skin is explicitly the graft route of the same capability, including vascularization, innervation, and growth with the patient as proposed completion elements.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The historical graft concept overlaps the preserved restoration capability.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Amended DER-02 so a universal systemic in vivo platform is a route and a safety requirement inside the same stem-cell cure.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: It is not a new concept.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Amended DER-03 with Bieber’s therapy-free remission definition, Ranzinger and Eyerich on controversial and uncommon psoriasis remission, and Chen and colleagues on a median relapse of about 3.29 months after IL-17 inhibitor withdrawal. Stated that an atopic dermatitis cure may still require barrier restoration.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Preserves the distinction between suppression and durable disease modification and the additional barrier requirement.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Amended DER-05 and DER-06 to reject a single all-cancer vaccine as a substitute demonstration.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The proposed interventions address ultraviolet-driven prevention and mutant fields, and the universal vaccine is an unsupported bundle.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Amended DER-08 to state that a full vitiligo cure is DER-03 plus DER-08.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Immune memory and a destroyed melanocyte reservoir are different barriers.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Amended DER-09 to refuse the historical extension to every chronic wound regardless of cause.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Ischemia, neuropathy, venous hypertension, and unrelieved pressure are separate drivers.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Amended DER-10 with verified authors and the 51-of-244 recurrence count from Cardenas and colleagues, and with Ellis and colleagues on adjuvant recurrence.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Adds the recurrence evidence stated in the notes.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Added the real NIAMS fiscal years 2025–2029 regenerative-medicine priority under DER-01.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Institutional context; it is a funding priority, not a completed method.
Hair control, skin-aging reversal, universal cancer vaccination, and intraoperative margin imaging were judged below the bar or already contained in a preserved concept.
